source.name: Company annual financial statements via Yahoo Finance

metadata.label: Corporate fundamentals of CapEx-sensitive companies
metadata.methodology: Five frozen capital-goods and five frozen infrastructure companies. All level growth rates are calculated within company and aggregated using the group median.
metadata.note: Order-book data are excluded because consistent machine-readable histories are unavailable. ROCE is a proxy using EBIT divided by total assets less current liabilities.

capital_goods_revenue_growth.label: Capital-goods companies: median revenue growth
capital_goods_revenue_growth.methodology: Unweighted median across the frozen five-company group; growth is calculated company by company before aggregation.
capital_goods_revenue_growth.source_note: Reporting dates and accounting classifications differ across companies; the basket is a case study, not the full index.
